chapter: Fourteen years with Nat Cole and the recording sessions
title: Sinatra's taste in musicians; Herbie Haymer
summary: Willard recalls Sinatra's early West Coast bandmates; Collins calls Herbie Haymer a dear friend and says both Sinatra and Nat were thrilling to work with.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Working with Sinatra: bands, Vegas and the Sands

blocks.x: He's always musicians, he's surrounded himself with.
Oh, yes, you know, it's the best.
And when he first came to the west coast in the early forties in Axel Stordahl's band, there was Dave Barbour, Herbie Haymer, Ziggy Elman,...
Yes, Herby was a very dear friend of

mine, a marvelous saxophone player. Yeah. But any way, that was most enjoyable. It was a thrill to work with Frank every night. This Nat was the same way. I -- as long as I worked with Nat I could be angry with him or peeved with him, but I always admired his performance, you know, he always did something to me. He was immaculate a performer.
